name: Fingercheck
description_en:
Fingercheck combines time tracking, scheduling, payroll and people operations for hourly and distributed teams. Its pricing separates a standalone Time & Attendance plan from 360 and 360 Plus payroll packages, with a custom 360 Pro option.

The useful evaluation follows approved hours into payroll and, where required, a job-specific report. Unlimited payroll runs do not mean every form, benefit, device or service is included, and the current promotional price is subject to back-loaded discount months and eligibility.
description_zh:
Fingercheck 为小时工及分布式团队组合工时、排班、工资和人员运营。定价区分独立 Time & Attendance 与包含工资的 360、360 Plus，另有定制 360 Pro。

评估可跟踪已批准工时进入工资，并按需要生成项目报告。工资运行不限次数不代表全部表单、福利、设备或服务均包含，当前优惠价也受后置优惠月份和资格约束。

core_features.name_zh: 小时工工时与工资联动
core_features.explanation_en: Time tracking supports multiple punch methods, shifts, job/task allocation and PTO, with payroll included only in the payroll tiers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工时支持多种打卡、班次、岗位任务分配和 PTO，工资仅在相应工资档位包含。

core_features.explanation_en: 360 describes unlimited runs, multi-state calculation, direct deposit and tax filing; year-end forms/filing can still add fees.
core_features.explanation_zh: 360 描述不限运行、多州计算、直接存款及报税，年末表单和申报仍可能另收费。

core_features.name_zh: 配置后的认证工资报告
core_features.explanation_en: Official help documents WH-347 and NYC report generation with required project parameters and configured classification and earning codes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方帮助说明生成 WH-347 和纽约市报告，需要项目参数及已配置的人员分类、收入编码。

pricing.summary_en: Standard monthly T&A $29+$7/employee, 360 $79+$10, Plus $129+$12; five-employee minimum, add-ons and year-end fees. Eligible Fall promotion applies months 4–6, not first three.
pricing.summary_zh: 标准月费考勤 29 美元加每人 7，360 为 79 加 10，Plus 为 129 加 12；最低按五人、另有附加及年末费。秋季资格优惠在第 4–6 月，非前三月。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.en: The platform targets hourly teams with mobile or hardware clocking, scheduling and payroll. The pricing page lists manual entry, multiple punch methods, shift differentials, job allocation and PTO. An illustrative pilot should include a worker using two pay rates, one missed punch and a corrected time entry before payroll approval. Compare the time record, taxable earnings and pay statement rather than relying on a “no errors” marketing claim. Real-time sync, geolocation, fraud detection and tax calculations were not executed or independently benchmarked.
sections.zh: 平台面向小时工团队，提供移动或硬件打卡、排班和工资。价格页列出人工录入、多种打卡、班次差额、岗位分配及 PTO。试运行示例可包含双费率员工、一次漏卡和工资批准前的工时更正，再比较工时、应税收入及工资单，不能依赖“无错误”宣传。本研究未执行或独立测量实时同步、位置、反欺诈及税务计算。

sections.title_en: Report creation still needs project parameters
sections.title_zh: 生成报告仍需项目参数
sections.en: The certified-payroll help gives a concrete administrator path: Reports → Payroll → Certified Payroll Reports, then select a payroll period, employees and additional parameters. For WH-347 it requires manually completing project/location, project or contract number and payroll number. Worker classification and regular/overtime earning codes must already be configured; optional job filters narrow the report. Preview, download, save or print are distinct from submitting the form to an agency. Demonstrate a job split and fringe-benefit mapping under the relevant contract; this draft does not validate legal deadlines or certify prevailing-wage compliance.
sections.zh: 认证工资帮助提供管理员路径：Reports → Payroll → Certified Payroll Reports，选择工资期间、员工及附加参数。WH-347 需手动填写项目地点、项目或合同编号及工资序号；人员分类和正常加班收入编码必须预先配置，可按岗位筛选。预览、下载、保存或打印与向机构提交不同。应按实际合同演示工作拆分及附加福利映射，本稿不验证法定期限，也不认证现行工资合规。

sections.title_en: Apply the minimum and the add-ons
sections.title_zh: 计入最低人数及附加项
sections.en: Time & Attendance lists $29 per month plus $7 per employee. Standard 360 lists $79 plus $10, and 360 Plus $129 plus $12, with a five-employee minimum spending requirement. For three employees, the published standard formula therefore implies $64, $129 or $189 monthly before additional charges, not a three-person variable fee. Only the latter two include payroll. Plus adds functions including next-day pay, team chat, benefits administration and workflows, subject to stated conditions. The table flags year-end forms and filing as extra, and insurance, 401(k) and other services can be add-ons. Confirm payroll funding eligibility, device costs and each extra in a quote.
sections.zh: Time & Attendance 列出每月 29 美元加每员工 7 美元；标准 360 为 79 加 10，360 Plus 为 129 加 12，并有五名员工等额最低消费。因此三人企业按公布标准公式分别为每月 64、129、189 美元，再加其他费用，而不是仅收三人的变量费。只有后两者包含工资。Plus 增加次日付款、团队聊天、福利管理和流程等，但有条件限制。表格标注年末表单及申报另收费，保险、401(k) 等也可能为附加项。需报价确认工资资金资格、设备及每项加费。

sections.title_en: Discount months come after the initial period
sections.title_zh: 优惠月份在初始期间之后
sections.en: The pricing cards show reduced amounts, but the Fall 2026 terms specify 50% off base and per-employee fees during service months 4–6, capped at $1,500 credit per month unless the vendor changes the cap. The one-time W-2/1099 forms discount is applied when billed in 2027. Eligible clients must be new payroll accounts on 360 or 360 Plus, or qualifying attendance-plan upgrades, and process their first payroll by December 16, 2026; signing up alone is insufficient. The promotion window is October 1–December 1 unless ended earlier, and add-ons or other fees are excluded. Budget from the standard schedule and written eligibility rather than assume the first three invoices are discounted.
sections.zh: 价格卡展示优惠金额，但 2026 年秋季条款规定基础费和人均费在服务第 4–6 月优惠 50%，每月抵扣上限 1,500 美元，除非供应商调整上限。W-2/1099 一次性表单优惠在 2027 年开票时应用。客户需为 360 或 360 Plus 新工资账户，或符合条件的考勤升级，并在 2026 年 12 月 16 日前首次处理工资，仅注册不够。优惠窗口为 10 月 1 日至 12 月 1 日，可提前终止，附加项及其他费用排除。预算应以标准价目及书面资格为准，不应假定前三张发票有折扣。

sections.title_en: The customer still owns payroll decisions
sections.en: The implementation page describes a specialist through kickoff, configuration, training and first payroll, then a support handoff. Its indicative timelines are about 30 days for a new business without YTD wages, six weeks for existing YTD imports and 12–14 weeks for complex or 150+ employee projects, not a universal six-day rollout. The same page explicitly says this is not a hands-off managed payroll service: customers retain data, compliance decisions and responses to tax notices. Prepare YTD wages, taxes, policies, job codes and approvers, then reconcile a parallel period and a correction. Exact implementation charges, signed contract, hosting, recovery, complete exports and source-code licensing remain unverified. No account, payroll, report or payment was executed.
sections.zh: 实施页描述专员从启动、配置、培训跟进至首次工资，再交接支持。其示意时间为无当年累计工资的新企业约 30 天、有历史累计导入约六周、复杂或 150 人以上约 12–14 周，不能泛化为六天全部上线。同页明确并非全权代管工资，客户仍负责数据、合规决定及税务通知回复。需准备累计工资税、政策、岗位编码及审批人，并行核对一期及一次更正。具体实施费、签署合同、托管、恢复、完整导出和源代码许可未核实，未执行账户、工资、报告或付款。
